read.en: MP Materials fell 5.8% on Oct 14 to $39.95 on heavy volume and is down 14% in five sessions. It is below all its averages, which are all falling: the 5-day ($43.6), 10-day ($45.3), 30-day ($48.7), 100-day ($52.8) and 200-day ($56.4). MACD has been below its signal since Aug 31 with a widening histogram below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($48.3), and RSI is 29, oversold.
read.zh: MP Materials 10月14日放量下跌 5.8%，收于 $39.95，五个交易日下跌 14%。股价位于所有均线下方，且各均线均在下行：5 日（$43.6）、10 日（$45.3）、30 日（$48.7）、100 日（$52.8）和 200 日（$56.4）。MACD 自 8月31日起位于信号线下方，柱状图在零轴下方扩大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$48.3），RSI 为 29，处于超卖区。

read.en: It closed just under the $40 round number (day's low $39.05), which becomes first resistance. The only support left above the lows is the $37.81 52-week low from Jul 29; below it, $35 is the next round number. Resistance is $40, then $42.4–43.6 (Oct 13 close, 5-day average) and $45.3 (10-day). A close below $37.8 would set a new 52-week low.
read.zh: 股价收于 $40 整数关口略下方（当日低点 $39.05），该位置转为第一阻力。低点之上唯一剩余的支撑为 7月29日的 52 周低点 $37.81；其下 $35 为下一个整数关口。阻力为 $40，其次 $42.4–43.6（10月13日收盘价、5 日均线）和 $45.3（10 日均线）。若收盘跌破 $37.8，将创 52 周新低。
